methods.evidence_sentence: TVR-Ranking: A Dataset for Ranked Video Moment Retrieval with Imprecise Queries In this paper, we propose the task of \textit{Ranked Video Moment Retrieval} (RVMR) to locate a ranked list of matching moments from a collection of videos, through queries in natural language.
